EXCLUSIVE: Ahead of the finale of hit K-drama The Remarried Empress, Korean actress Shin Mina, who plays Empress Navier in the show, talked to Deadline about her experiences of playing the role and shared her thoughts on why the show is such a huge success.

She also shared some tips on what viewers could look out for in the final two episodes, which are dropping on Disney+ and Hulu later today (November 25).

Also starring Ju Jihoon, Lee Jongsuk and Lee Seyoung, The Remarried Empress has been a breakout hit in Korea and internationally, becoming the most viewed local original premiere of all time on Disney+ globally, just three days after its launch on November 3.

Premiere views increased worldwide around 40% between its first and second weeks of streaming, with Latin America leading as the fastest-growing region, with views increasing by 43%, followed by APAC and EMEA at 39% and the U.S. at 37%.

Based on a Naver webtoon, the story revolves around Empress Navier and her dignified response when her husband, Emperor Sovieshu of the Eastern Kingdom, takes a slave girl as a concubine and suggests marrying her. While keeping her composure, Navier becomes closer to Crown Prince Heinrey, who can take the form of a magical bird. At the end of episode eight, we saw Navier inform her husband that would she accompany the Prince to the Western Kingdom to attend his coronation as king following his father’s death.

This was Shin’s first time playing an Empress in a romantasy epic, although she found some common ground with characters she’s played before: “I’ve appeared in a period drama before, Arang And The Magistrate, a fantasy-infused historical series, but I played a ghost in that one, so it was a very different experience from a traditional historical drama,” she tells Deadline.

“This time, even though the setting is an imaginary era, playing a character with a symbolic status in a world with social classes felt new to me. Above all, I loved that Navier’s dignity, strength, and wisdom are at the heart of the story. And I thought she was an incredibly proactive and appealing character, since in the end she chooses to remarry on her own terms.”

Shin admits she also got a kick out of wearing so many different styles of dresses. While Korean period dramas are usually filmed in traditional Hanbok, The Remarried Empress uses European-style costumes and sets and was filmed in castles and palaces in Germany and the Czech Republic.

“I wore so many dresses and tried so many different hairstyles. I kept thinking, ‘when will I ever get to film in dresses this gorgeous again?’ so I enjoyed every moment while acting. Of course, the costumes weren’t always comfortable,” Shin laughs.

But while she plays an Empress in a fantasy setting in the series, Shin says Navier is not so different to characters she’s played before: “There are seeds of love in Navier’s heart, too. As they slowly sprout, she realizes how she truly feels and chooses a new love. I think those emotional shifts, and the moments of facing love, connect with the characters in other romance projects I’ve played.”

蒙蒂斯饰演芬恩·哈德森 (Finn Hudson)，该剧的男主角、四分卫出身的欢乐合唱团成员，直至 2013 年 7 月因意外服药过量去世。同年 10 月，该剧在第五季中推出了一集名为“四分卫”的剧集，向蒙蒂思致敬，同时也解释了哈德森在剧中的去世。 （这一集没有提及哈德森是如何死的。）

“拍摄[致敬剧集]《四分卫》……我认为这不是正确的事情，”乌什科维茨周一在“我们需要谈谈”播客上说道。 “我认为每个人都一致认为这可能不是我们应该做的事情，因为我们在私下和公开场合都感到悲伤。”

“我认为粉丝们肯定需要一些东西，因为他们像我们一样深爱科里，也深爱芬恩，”她说。 “但让你的朋友悲伤，同时又让他们的朋友悲伤，这是一件非常困难的事情。”

Jenna Ushkowitz, who starred as Tina Cohen-Chang for the entirety of “Glee,” is reflecting on how the Fox series addressed the real-life death of her fellow cast member Cory Monteith, and why she now feels it “wasn’t the right thing” to do at the time.

Monteith played Finn Hudson, the show’s leading man and quarterback-turned-Glee club member, until he died of an accidental overdose in July 2013. The show honored the actor with a Season 5 episode titled “The Quarterback” that October, a tribute to Monteith that also explained Hudson’s passing within the context of the show. (The episode makes no mention of how Hudson died.)

“To shoot [the tribute episode] ‘The Quarterback’… I think it wasn’t the right thing,” Ushkowitz said on the “We Need to Talk” podcast Monday. “And I think everybody collectively agrees that it’s maybe not the thing that we should have done, because we were grieving both privately and publicly.”

“I think the fans definitely needed something, because they loved Cory so dearly like we did, and [loved] Finn so dearly,” she said. “But it’s a really hard thing to be grieving your friend and be a character grieving their friend at the same time.”

“It was like, too soon for that. [It] was not fun, [I] don’t want to remember that time,” she continued. “The show itself was never the same. He was the heart of the show, our friend, most importantly, and our leader. He really was the quarterback for us. He held everybody together. He hosted parties for the crew. He was the kindest. He knew everybody’s names. He just was such a good person, a kind person.”

Ushkowitz also noted that the “nobody” on the show “had the tools to deal with” Monteith’s death. “Even our creators, they were dealing with grief too. So nobody had the tools.”

“Glee” first premiered in Sept. 2009, and in addition to Monteith and Ushkowitz, starred Lea Michele, Naya Rivera, Dianna Agron, Matthew Morrison, Jane Lynch, Heather Morris, Chris Colfer and more. A reboot of the show was set at Disney+ and Hulu in October.

Speaking with Variety earlier this month, co-creator Ian Brennan said he’s “really excited about it.” “It’s going to be a lot of fun,” he added. “We’re still figuring a lot of it out,” Brennan said on addressing the deaths of Monteith and Rivera, who died in 2020. “That’s going to be part of it, that sadness and that loss. items.content:
中新网北京11月25日电 (记者 应妮)以一条真实的航线为骨架，在丰沛的历史细节之中，写出一部属于汉语的远洋史诗。作家邓一光潜心创作的长篇小说《闭上眼睛》日前由人民文学出版社推出。

八十万字的《闭上眼睛》以1839年鸦片战争前夕的广州黄埔港为起点，循着漫长的远洋航路，讲述少年九灯护送岭南植物远赴伦敦邱园，最终重返粤港、往来南洋，成为一位博物学者的历程。作品融海洋、历史、地理、博物、文明对话于一体，既是一个人的成长史，也记录了一个文明转身的时刻。

人民文学出版社社长陈义望表示，邓一光长期患有眼疾，创作这部长篇时右眼近乎失明，却一头扎进海量的历史、地理、博物学资料，一点点甄别提炼。近代海上航行、跨洋往来的记载，大量留存于各种档案之中，他将散落在史料里的航路节点、口岸百态、人际际遇，转化为长篇小说的文学世界。这部小说“以独特的方式重新看见文明相遇时复杂多面的现场，为文明互鉴提供了一份沉静、克制的文本参照”。

美国商船船长、英国植物学家、日本籍传教士、各国外交官、公行贸易商、旗人家族、疍人家庭、流浪女童……在一处处港湾，九灯与一个个鲜活生命相识相知、生离死别或失而复得。《当代》杂志主编徐晨亮谈及小说结构时感慨，全书上下两卷共二十九章，每章标题都以“在”字起笔：在大关、在南海、在印度洋、在大西洋、在伦敦、在归途、在故土、在太平洋……人物的生命在各个空间方位里持续流动。“这对写作者是难度极高的挑战：不仅是空间转换时的所见所闻与身体感知，还要让主人公在巨变的时代里，和历史擦肩而过或是劈面相逢，与诸多重要人物产生命运交集。”

中国社会科学院研究员刘大先表示，海洋在邓一光笔下是“老师一样的角色，给我们成长的摇篮一样的角色”，这本书的宏阔在于，既可以说它是博物志式的书写，也可以说是类似于流浪汉小说漂泊志、航海记或者个人回忆录、成长小说，甚至是文明论意义上的小说。

在小说中，因缘际会，十二岁的少年随一艘美国商船护送植物远赴伦敦邱园。借由标本、画作、手稿与园中的植株，他与胡克父子、亨斯洛、福琼、达尔文、华莱士、诺斯这些大自然的探索者相逢；走出邱园，在伦敦的街巷、沙龙与书房之间，他又和狄更斯、拉斯金、莫里斯等时代人物置身同一片精神场域，目睹了欧洲工业革命的突进和璀璨文化群星点亮新的时代。中国人民大学文学院教授杨庆祥认为，九灯被塑造为生长在中西交汇夹缝中的孤儿，穿行在两种文明之间，他怀抱理想主义，以草木之学安身，主动奔赴未知。作者让一个亚细亚的孤儿直接进入欧洲文明最深刻的内核，在这个意义上开拓了中国当代汉语写作的全新视角，“他从历史的烟尘中走来，实际上他也是活在当下的人物，带有强烈的现实问题意识。”

邓一光在文坛成名已久，曾获首届鲁迅文学奖、中宣部“五个一工程”奖、人民文学奖、中国出版政府奖等奖项，长篇小说《我是我的神》入选“新中国70年70部长篇小说典藏”。(完)

items.content:
Matrix 是少数派的写作社区，我们主张分享真实的产品体验，有实用价值的经验与思考。我们会不定期挑选 Matrix 最优质的文章，展示来自用户的最真实的体验和观点。

在上期《怀旧手记》中，我为大家科普并分享了 Palm OS 阵营当中的索尼 CLIE。

本期《怀旧手记》依旧和 Palm 有关，接下来要和大家分享的是 2009 年 Palm 的「转型之作」——Palm Pre 和 webOS。

在正文开始前，想必有很多人听说过 webOS 但并不了解。所以，在此我想问大家一个问题：你现在使用的是什么品牌的手机？运行的是什么操作系统？在使用手机的过程当中，最「无关紧要」但「必不可缺」的动作是什么？

我先来回答：我使用的是 vivo 的手机，运行的是基于安卓定制的 OriginOS；除此之外，我还有一台 iPhone，运行 iOS。在日常使用当中，最「无关紧要」但「必不可缺」的动作我认为是：在管理应用时，手指从屏幕底部向上滑动并短暂停留，呼出「卡片式后台」进行切换或关闭。

把时间拨回 2009 年。当时的智能手机市场，主流毫无疑问是诺基亚的塞班（Symbian）和新晋苹果的 iPhone OS。这两个系统在当时的交互逻辑截然不同：一个坚持「真后台」的多任务运转，另一个在第三方应用层面仅支持单任务。

但它们的共同点在于：在那个时代，没人知道一套直观、优雅的多任务交互逻辑究竟该怎么做。

最早把「卡片式后台」和「上滑手势」作为系统核心交互的，是以 PDA 闻名的老牌厂商Palm。以及它孤注一掷带来的全新系统——webOS。

提起 Palm 想必很多人还是和我一样会想起经典的 PDA（个人数字助理），最经典的莫过于 Graffiti 手写识别。

和苹果的 Newton 不同，Palm 在字母识别这一块，不是让机器去试图适应人的操作，而是让人学会一套固定的「动作」来操控机器。

11月25日，由腾讯魔方工作室自研的多人动作竞技新作《狩》，正式公布了首支宣传PV。

这是一款以近战动作为核心的多人竞技游戏。除了不同风格的角色与丰富的武器系统之外，游戏还准备了包括赛事模式（吃鸡玩法）、1V1、3V3在内的多种竞技玩法，并采用了颇具辨识度的街头潮流美术风格。从官方首次展示的内容来看，《狩》希望让玩家在激烈的对抗中打出华丽的连招，享受动作竞技带来的战斗乐趣。

而在游戏正式公布之前，我受邀参加了《狩》的线下媒体试玩会，提前体验到了这款作品。

在活动现场，官方邀请了不少游戏媒体、KOL以及UP主来到现场，除了安排大家亲自上手体验之外，还将参与者之间的对战搬到了这座擂台上。场地后方的大屏幕则实时播放着战斗画面，让其他人也能观看比赛。

这样的安排倒是很符合《狩》本身的气质。当两名玩家在擂台上展开较量，身后的大屏幕同步呈现出各种华丽的连招与激烈的攻防时，整个现场也有了几分动作竞技赛事的味道。即使只是站在一旁观看，也很容易被比赛的气氛所感染。

当然，看别人打得热闹是一回事，自己上手又是另一回事。

这次试玩，官方为我们提供了PC设备，我总共体验了大约两个小时，参与了四场比赛，其中包括两场三人组队的赛事模式，以及两场1V1对抗。在三排模式中，我的队友也都是受邀到场的其他媒体老师。并且在这四场比赛中，我还很有幸“吃了一次鸡”。

虽然总体的体验时间不算太长，但几场比赛下来，《狩》还是给我留下了比较深刻的印象。它的战斗节奏很快，玩家之间的交锋也相当紧张，再加上充满风格化的动作演出，让整个战斗过程显得十分热闹。

而在这些直观的感受之外，我觉得《狩》更值得聊一聊的，还是它的战斗系统。

对于一款以近战为核心的多人动作竞技游戏来说，战斗系统显然是它最重要的部分。在实际体验之后，我觉得《狩》比较有意思的地方，就是它把基础操作设计得相当简单：即使是第一次接触游戏的玩家，也能轻松地衔接不同招式，完成一套颇为华丽的连续攻击。

Variety Awards Circuit section is the home for all awards news and related content throughout the year, featuring the following: the official predictions for the upcoming Oscars, Emmys, Grammys and Tony Awards ceremonies, curated by Variety chief awards editor Clayton Davis. The prediction pages reflect the current standings in the race and do not reflect personal preferences for any individual contender. As other formal (and informal) polls suggest, competitions are fluid and subject to change in response to buzz and events. Predictions are updated every Thursday.

Golden Globes Predictions Commentary (Updated: Nov. 24, 2026): Golden Globe voting is underway! Here’s the breakdown of all the submissions.

Eighty-eight films were submitted for best motion picture (drama), and 43 are competing for best motion picture (musical or comedy). Among the drama submissions are Christopher Nolan’s “The Odyssey” and Denis Villeneuve’s “Dune: Part Three.” The musical or comedy field also includes Destin Daniel Cretton’s “Spider-Man: Brand New Day” and David Fincher’s “The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth.”

In the lead acting races, the drama category for best actor has 69 submissions representing 64 performers with Brad Pitt in contention for “Heart of the Beast,” alongside Robert Pattinson for “Primetime.” The musical or comedy category features 32 submissions from 31 performers, including Tom Holland for “Spider-Man: Brand New Day” and Ryan Gosling for “Project Hail Mary.”

The best actress (drama) race has 39 submissions from 39 performers, with Zendaya (“Dune: Part Three”) and Anne Hathaway (“Verity”) among the contenders. The musical or comedy field has 23 submissions from 22 performers. Meryl Streep returns as Miranda Priestly in “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” while Olivia Wilde earns two entries, for “I Want Your Sex” and “The Invite.”

The acting races are led by the supporting actor category, which boasts 221 submissions from 198 performers, making it the most crowded of the six acting fields. Mark Ruffalo has three entries in the supporting category alone: “Being Heumann,” “Crime 101,” and “Spider-Man: Brand New Day.” The supporting actress category has 158 submissions from 146 performers. Florence Pugh appears twice, for “Dune: Part Three” and “Spider-Man: Brand New Day,” while Zendaya is also a double entrant, with submissions for “The Odyssey” and “Spider-Man: Brand New Day” that go along with her two leading bids.

Behind the camera, 131 filmmakers are attached to 123 films in the best director race, including Steven Spielberg for “Disclosure Day” and Nolan for “The Odyssey.” The screenplay category features 121 submissions, among them Quentin Tarantino’s script for “The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth” and Drew Goddard’s adaptation of “Project Hail Mary.”

The music categories include 100 submissions for best original score, with John Williams (“Disclosure Day”) and Hans Zimmer (“Dune: Part Three”) among the composers in contention. Best original song has 51 entries, including Taylor Swift and Jack Antonoff’s “I Knew It, I Knew You” from “Toy Story 5,” as well as two submissions from Diane Warren.

The animated feature category has 24 eligible films, including Andrew Stanton’s “Toy Story 5” and Brad Bird’s “Ray Gunn.” Meanwhile, 42 films are submitted for best motion picture (non-English language), including Ryusuke Hamaguchi’s “All of a Sudden,” representing Japan, and Lee Chang-dong’s “Possible Love,” representing South Korea.

The cinematic and box office achievement category features 20 submissions, among them “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” starring Streep, and surprisingly, “The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth.”Across all categories, 170 distinct films have been submitted, while the six acting categories account for 475 different performers.

items.originalContent:
Editorial Director/Box Office Editor

Lionsgate’s The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping will have all the fire to keep the Thanksgiving box office stretch cooking with at least $70M between Wednesday and Sunday per industry estimates at the domestic B.O.. Five-day forecasts are hard, duh, and once we’re into Black Friday, the richest day of the frame, does it become apparent how much overdrive is in the box office.

Already today Sunrise on the Reaping is heading to an estimated $16M which is both the best Tuesday Lionsgate has ever seen for a movie, and also a franchise Tuesday record besting Catching Fire’s $15.96M. Today is also bound to be higher than Wicked: For Good‘s first Tuesday a year ago which was $15.7M. That will take the Francis Lawrence directed pic’s running cume through five days to $148.2M, $18.1M away from overtaking the $166.3M lifetime North American total on the last Hunger Games: Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes three years ago.

Remember, Sunrise on the Reaping will cede some of its Imax screens, specifically AMC’s, to Netflix’s limited run of Once Upon a Time in Hollywood sequel, the Brad Pitt starring The Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth which will be booked at 250 locations for a two week run and arrive on Netflix 28-days after its Wednesday bow. The David Fincher directed, Quentin Tarantino written feature is 82% certified fresh on Rotten Tomatoes with critics (Once Upon a Time in Hollywood was 86% certified fresh) and is looking at single digits over 5-days. Last year, Netflix’s Wake Up Dead Man: A Knives Out Mystery only made $4M over the Wednesday-Sunday stretch at 600 locations.

Among the new stuff, Walt Disney Animation’s original animated title Hexed should be stronger than Universal/Paramount’s Focker-in-Law when it comes to global openings (5-day domestic + the regular foreign weekend of Wednesday to Sunday), $75M WW to $70M.

Domestically right now via Universal, the bet is that the added high note of Ariana Grande to 26-year old Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro Meet the Parents comedy franchise will have the upper hand with a $45M Wednesday to Sunday (there aren’t any Tuesday night previews, through showtimes start at midnight) at 3,350 theaters, despite awful reviews at 28% Rotten. Reviews have always been bad for the Fockers films, except for the 2000 original which stands at 85% certified fresh. Uni will have some PLFs. Older women over 25 are best in first choice, followed by younger women (under 25) and men over 25.

In the $90M net production, which was evenly co-bankrolled by Uni and Paramount, Greg Focker’s son, Henry, brings his girlfriend, a trained FBI hostage negotiator, home to meet the family. Greg soon gets worried when Henry (Skyler Gisondo) tells everyone that he plans to propose to her. Paramount is a co-financier here having inherited the property from the days when they had an interest in DreamWorks, the previous co-studio on the franchise.

Paramount overseas will release Focker-in-Law in 62 territories except for Japan. Comps abroad for comedies, particularly, non-gross out films, are hard. Little Fockers in like-for-likes, the last movie in the series back in 2010, bowed to $25M abroad. The best comp post Covid is the Sandra Bullock-Channing Tatum adventure romcom, Lost City, which opened to $25M in like-for-likes and $55.4M WW. There’s been a big effort by Paramount to tailor the jokes to each territory. Meet the Parents has always On Little Fockers, Western Europe ruled with UK, Germany, France, and Spain the strongest followed by Australia. There’s been roughly an even split between the final domestic and foreign on the Meet the Parents movies. Through three movies, the Meet the Parents movies count $1.16 billion at the global box office.

Disney’s $200M production Hexed could be light. Domestic was originally at $45M over 5-day and now it could be at $40M or below at 3,725 theatres, including 800 Premium Large Format screens, 1,800 3D screens, and 250 Motion screens. Reviews are not so hot at 65% fresh on RT. Previews begin today at 2pm, and they’re around $2M we hear (that’s just above Encanto‘s $1.5M which was a 5-day of $40.5M). Even though Moana 2 and Zootopia 2 opened to respective massive Tuesday previews of $13.8M and $10.2M, it’s always about the days after for the Disney animated pics. Unlike other Disney Animation movies, there aren’t any original songs in this movie about a mother and daughter which voiced by Rashida Jones and Hailee Steinfeld. It’s all needle drops of pop hits, like Dua Lipa’s “Levitating”. Best first choice by a stretch for Hexed is women under 25, one point above where Disney/Pixar’s Hoppers was before opening to a 3-day of $45.3M.

Overseas, Hexed is eyeing $35M-$40M with a 92% footprint. Like for like comps are Hoppers ($57M foreign opening), Elemental ($45M), Wish ($40M), and Encanto ($30M). Tomorrow the Jason Hand and Fawn Veerasunthorn directed movie will bow in Belgium, Czech Rep, France, Korea, Netherlands, Philippines, Poland, South Africa, and Switzerland. Thursday will be Argentina, Australia, Austria, Bolivia, Brazil, Central America, Chile, Colombia, Croatia, Denmark, Ecuador, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Italy, Malaysia, Mexico, New Zealand, Paraguay, Peru, Portugal, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Taiwan, Thailand, Trinidad, UAE, Ukraine, Uruguay, Venezuela. Friday is China, Finland, India, Indonesia, Norway, Spain, Sweden, Turkey, UK, and Vietnam. Saturday is Hong Kong.

items.content:
《警察模拟器》发布最新预告片，展示警员创建与装备系统法雷蒙特市的犯罪案件有所增加，其中还包括汽车盗窃。市民们正需要玩家的帮助。作为新加入警队的一员，玩家将前往最近的警局，开始自己的首次值勤。

最新公开的“成为一名警察”预告片，展示了玩家即将体验的警员生活：

Steam地址：https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825550/

首次进入行动中心之前，玩家可以使用全新的角色创建系统，选择角色的性别与族裔，并从多种脸型、体型、眼睛与发色、发型和配音中进行搭配。男性角色还可以选择不同的胡须样式。最后，别忘了为角色填写姓名——准备就绪后，你就可以正式开始工作了。

角色创建完成后，前往行动中心。这里采用了尽量减少菜单干扰的设计，让玩家能够更直接地融入《警察模拟器》的世界。更衣室提供多种服装与配饰，包括衬衫、裤子、背心、夹克、头饰，以及眼镜、手套和手表等。隔壁的军械室则备有适合当班使用的装备，例如枪械、测速雷达枪、交通锥、相机和警戒带。随着游戏进程推进，玩家也可以在这里领取警车钥匙。

准备好了吗？回到行动中心的主区域，警务电脑已经准备好你的首班任务。屏幕上还会显示城市概览，包括各个城区和街区的犯罪指数。接下来就由你努力降低这些数字，并逐步解锁更多区域与任务。

现在，开启你的第一班吧！乘坐行动中心内的电梯前往警局大厅，再从那里走上法雷蒙特市的街头。祝你值勤顺利，警官！

作为热门作品《警察模拟器：巡警》的正统续作，《警察模拟器》将带来许多全新内容。这些新功能既吸收了社区反馈，也融入了布拉格开发团队 GRIP Studios 的全新构想。玩家将首次加入法雷蒙特市警察局，以一名警员的身份开启职业生涯，并从游戏伊始体验这些新内容。

《警察模拟器》计划于 2027 年登陆 PC、PlayStation5 和 Xbox Series X|S。

探索三座各具特色的城区，领略以美国城市为灵感打造的法雷蒙特市

Daedalic Entertainment 与 Black Deer Games 宣布，动作塔防游戏《维京防线：北境之风》将开启第二次测试。

新玩家和曾参与首次测试的玩家现可通过 Steam 报名参加第二次测试。测试将于 12 月 2 日开启。Daedalic 同时发布了全新实机预告片，展现游戏融合塔防、策略与 RPG 式成长系统的独特玩法。

《维京防线：北境之风》Steam 页面，参与测试：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3618000/Hordeguard_Winds_of_the_North/

敌人突袭：探索地图时，玩家将遭遇出其不意、难以预测的敌人袭击。

10 种全新被动技能：在据点之外探索并获得被动能力，为战斗带来更多策略选择。

存档续战：玩家可以从上次推进到的敌人波次继续关卡，迅速重返战斗。

全新指挥面板：玩家可以下达命令，让士兵跟随、驻守、前往指定位置，或在合作模式中前往另一名玩家身边，在激烈战斗中更灵活地指挥部队。

新增语言支持：游戏现已支持 15 种语言，包括英语、斯洛伐克语、法语、德语、西班牙语、捷克语、俄语、简体中文和繁体中文。完整语言列表请参阅 Steam 页面。

《维京防线：北境之风》的首次测试吸引了 50,000 名玩家参与。Black Deer Games 根据玩家反馈，为游戏加入了更多功能并调整了玩法体验。

第二次测试还将带来男女英雄配音、箭雨与锤击技能升级、更聪明的士兵单位、可供玩家手动控制的攻击方式，以及更多样化的支线任务奖励。
